intro: The Seychelles is a presidential republic with peaceful elections.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years. The National Assembly passes laws. In 2020 the opposition won power for the first time.

chapters.title: Protecting nature
text: About half the land and a third of the sea are protected.
